design_rules: 1 deck per guide — all 8 sessions in one file, navigated by the instructor
Max 7 lines of text per slide — split into two slides if needed
Formal evidence slides (E1–E6): MINIMAL layout only — no vocabulary visible, no distractors
Listening slides: ONLY a guiding question + headphones icon — NO script text
Session title slides: full navy background, session number large orange top-left
Word Wall slide: category table with color-coded headers — orange for Safety category
Communication Map slide: F1–F5 table — fixed, reusable across S4 and S5
Task instructions always marked with ► arrow in orange
Time + grouping always shown at bottom of activity slides
Slides support the instructor — they are NOT the lesson. The lesson is in the Learning Guide.

slides.title: The Workshop Specialist
content: Mantenimiento de Motores Diesel
Guía de Aprendizaje No 1 — CEFR A1.1
RAP 220501096 — Comunicar información técnica en inglés
SENA · Programa Técnico
slides.image: Full-bleed background: diesel workshop with mechanic in PPE inspecting a service bay. Dark overlay 40%.
slides.design_notes: Full navy background with background image at 40% opacity. Title white Arial Bold 40pt. Subtitle orange 28pt. Program name white Calibri 22pt. Logo SENA bottom-right.
slides.speaker_notes: Project while learners enter the room on Session 1. No introduction needed — image speaks.

slides.title: Our Journey — 8 Sessions
content: S1  The Wake-Up Call         →  Reflexión Inicial
S2  Read the Workshop        →  Contextualización     ● E1 Reading
S3  Write It Right           →  Apropiación           ● E2 Writing
S4  Tuning In & Speaking Up  →  Apropiación           ● E3 Listening + E4 Speaking
S5  The Workshop in Action   →  Apropiación           ● E5 Language Functions
S6  Prove What You Know      →  Apropiación           ● E6 Cuestionario (25 pts)
S7–S8  The Final Mission     →  Transferencia
slides.design_notes: 2-column table layout. Left: session title. Right: phase + evidence dot (orange ●). Evidence sessions highlighted with orange dot. Body Calibri 20pt. Header row navy. Return to this slide at the start of each new session and point to 'We are here'.
slides.speaker_notes: Show at course start AND at start of each session. Instructor points: 'Today we are here.' Return to this overview at the end of each session to show progress.

slides.title: Session 1: The Wake-Up Call
content: Fase SENA: Reflexión Inicial
Focus: Activar conocimiento previo del taller diesel
Estrategia: Estudio de casos + KWL + Diagnóstico
Habilidades: Speaking · Listening · Vocabulary
Duración: 6 horas
slides.image: Optional: aerial view of diesel workshop.
slides.design_notes: Full navy. S1 orange 64pt top-left. Title white Arial Bold 36pt. Bullets orange Calibri 22pt.
slides.speaker_notes: Project at start of S1. Read objective aloud. Then move to slide 4.

slides.title: SET-UP — Welcome to the Workshop
content: "Look around. Think about a diesel workshop."
"What do you see? What do you hear? What do you smell?"
"What is the most dangerous thing in a diesel workshop?"
► Think: 1 minute alone. Then share with the group.
Time: 20 min | Whole group
slides.image: Small image: diesel workshop interior, clean and organized.
slides.design_notes: White background. Navy title. Teacher Talk in italic. Task instruction (►) in orange box. Time + grouping in gray bottom caption.
slides.speaker_notes: Instructor reads Teacher Talk aloud. No correction. Goal: lower affective filter. Accept L1 responses at this stage.

slides.title: [A] The Headline — Safety Awareness
content: 📰 "Three mechanics hospitalized after workshop fire"
"— investigators blame poor PPE compliance"
► Read the headline. In your group — discuss:
(1) What happened?  (2) Why?  (3) What is PPE?
(4) What should they do next?
► Write your answers on post-its. Post on the Safety Wall.
Time: 50 min | Groups of 3–4 → Safety Wall → Plenary
slides.image: Small: newspaper/alert icon. Or: workshop fire safety image.
slides.design_notes: Headline text in large italic navy, visual newspaper frame. Questions numbered clearly. Task instruction (►) in orange. Safety Wall reminder in caption.
slides.speaker_notes: Read headline aloud with learners. Do NOT explain PPE yet — let them discover. Collect post-its and display them on the wall. Use them as vocabulary anchors.

slides.title: [B] Meet the Team — The Diesel Workshop
content: Carlos Mendoza — Lead Technician
Valentina Cruz — Safety Officer
Santiago Ríos — Apprentice Technician
► Look at the three characters. What do they do?
► Which character are you most similar to?
Time: 40 min | Pairs → Plenary
slides.image: Three character cards side by side: placeholder portrait + name + role label. Navy name, orange role.
slides.design_notes: Three equally-sized character cards. Each: placeholder portrait silhouette + name in navy bold + role in orange italic. Clean white background. Characters recur throughout all sessions.
slides.speaker_notes: These three characters appear in every session. Establish them clearly. Ask: 'Who is responsible for safety?' — use as discussion seed.

slides.title: [C] KWL — What Do You Know?
content: K — What I KNOW about diesel workshop English
W — What I WANT to learn
L — What I LEARNED ← Fill in Session 8
► Individual: Fill columns K and W (5 min)
► Share: 2 items from your K column with the class
Time: 50 min | Individual → Pairs → Plenary
slides.design_notes: KWL table: 3 columns, header row navy. K and W columns white. L column light gray with 'Fill in Session 8' watermark text. Keep this slide available throughout S1.
slides.speaker_notes: Distribute the KWL worksheet from the Learning Guide. This slide is the model. Column L stays empty — it closes the learning cycle in S8.

slides.title: WRAP-UP S1 — Gap Card + Preview
content: Gap Card: Rate yourself 1–5 on the 6 I can statements
Save your Gap Card — you'll need it in Session 8!
► Exit ticket: One word in English about safety in this workshop
Preview S2: We read about diesel tools. We build the Word Wall.
Autonomous work: Study 5 Toolbelt words you don't know yet.
slides.design_notes: White background. Gap Card reminder in orange highlight box. Preview S2 in gray italic. Exit ticket instruction in orange.
slides.speaker_notes: Collect Gap Cards from all learners. Store them — redistribute only in S8. One-word exit ticket: instructor writes words on board. Close with energy.

slides.title: Session 2: Read the Workshop
content: Fase SENA: Contextualización
Focus: Vocabulario técnico (20 términos) + Comprensión lectora
Estrategia: CLIL + Content-Based Learning + Jigsaw
Evidencia: E1 — Cuestionario No 1 (Reading · 5 pts)
Duración: 6 horas
slides.design_notes: Full navy. S2 orange 64pt. Title white 36pt. E1 evidence marker in orange circle.
slides.speaker_notes: Return to Overview slide 2 first — point to S2. Then show this title.

slides.title: SET-UP S2 — Workshop Images
content: ► Look at these 4 images. What tools do you see?
► Name as many tools as you can — in English.
► What category does each tool belong to?
Preview: Today we read about these tools.
Time: 20 min | Pairs → Whole group
slides.image: 4-image grid: (1) hand tools on workbench, (2) floor jack lifting vehicle, (3) PPE equipment, (4) diesel specialist at workbench. Source: Shadow Foam / workshop photography.
slides.design_notes: Split layout: left = 2×2 image grid (images from Shadow Foam article or equivalent). Right = task instruction in orange box. Images should show real workshop tools, not illustrations.
slides.speaker_notes: This activates prior vocabulary. Do not teach yet — just activate. Collect vocabulary on the board for later comparison with the Word Wall.

slides.title: [A] The Toolbelt — 20 Words
content: Environment: workshop · service bay · workbench · toolbox
Tools & Equipment: wrench · ratchet · socket · torque wrench · floor jack
Safety: PPE · safety goggles · gloves · hazard · spill · fire extinguisher
Maintenance: preventive maintenance · corrective maintenance
Documents & Roles: work order · checklist · specialist
► Which 5 do you already know? Circle them mentally.
Time: 30 min | Whole group → Word Wall build
slides.design_notes: 5-row category table. Row headers navy bold left column. Terms Calibri 20pt right column. Safety row: light orange background highlight. Keep this slide visible during Word Wall construction.
slides.speaker_notes: Do NOT read list aloud — learners read it. Instructor marks stress on board for each new term. The physical Word Wall cards go on the classroom wall as this slide is shown.

slides.title: [B] Flashcard Battle — Pronunciation Drill
content: Partner A: show image → Partner B: say term + pronounce + use in a sentence
► Stress marks — say with me:
WORK-shop · FLOOR JACK · SAFE-ty GOG-gles
FIRE ex-TING-guish-er · SPE-cial-ist
► Flashcard battle: most correct cards in 5 minutes — wins!
Time: 40 min | Pairs
slides.image: Small: flashcard icon or two learners with cards.
slides.design_notes: Stress marks in orange bold for each term. Rules of flashcard battle in numbered list. Timer suggestion in caption. Clean white background.
slides.speaker_notes: Model the drill first with a volunteer. Instructor choral drills the 5 hardest terms before pairs start: fire extinguisher backchaining: -guisher → extinguisher → fire extinguisher.

slides.title: [C] Jigsaw Reading — Section Assignment
content: Section A: The Workshop (workshop, service bay, workbench, toolbox)
Section B: Hand Tools (wrench, ratchet, socket, torque wrench)
Section C: Safety Tools (floor jack, PPE, goggles, gloves)
Section D: The Specialist (specialist, maintenance, work order, checklist)
► Read YOUR section. Find: 3 Toolbelt terms + 1 There is/are sentence.
► Then: teach your section to your expert group.
Time: 80 min | Individual reading → Expert groups → Home groups
slides.design_notes: 4-row section table. Section letter in orange circle. Section title navy bold. Key terms in gray italic. Task instruction in orange box below table. Steps numbered.
slides.speaker_notes: Assign sections clearly: rows 1-2 = A, rows 3-4 = B, rows 5-6 = C, rows 7-8 = D. After individual reading: form expert groups (all A's together, etc.). Then home groups.

slides.title: Cuestionario No 1 — Reading Comprehension
content: EVIDENCIA No 1 — Conocimiento
5 questions · 15 minutes · No text · No notes
► Wait for the instructor's signal to begin.
slides.design_notes: MINIMAL layout. White background. Title navy centered 28pt. Evidence label in orange box. Instructions Calibri 22pt centered. Nothing else on this slide — no vocabulary, no images.
slides.speaker_notes: Collect all texts and notes before distributing the quiz. Do NOT give oral feedback before collecting. 15 minutes strict.

slides.title: WRAP-UP S2 — Word Wall Lives Here
content: Word Wall: 20 terms — visible in this classroom for ALL sessions
Exit ticket: Write one sentence using There is/are + a Toolbelt term
Preview S3: We write a Daily Inspection Checklist in English.
Autonomous work: Self-test all 20 flashcards (2 rounds) + Preview grammar
slides.image: Small: Word Wall photo example (physical cards on classroom wall).
slides.design_notes: Word Wall reminder in orange highlight. Exit ticket instruction in navy box. Preview S3 in gray italic caption.
slides.speaker_notes: The Word Wall stays on the classroom wall for the rest of the course. Exit ticket: collect 2–3 sentences from volunteers. Write them on board — celebrate.

slides.title: Session 3: Write It Right
content: Fase SENA: Apropiación
Focus: Gramática técnica + Escritura de documentos del taller
Estrategia: Grammar Discovery + Task-Based Learning
Evidencia: E2 — Daily Inspection Checklist (Producto · 5 pts)
Duración: 6 horas
slides.design_notes: Full navy. S3 orange 64pt. E2 evidence marker in orange circle.
slides.speaker_notes: Return to Overview slide 2 — point to S3. Then show this.

slides.title: [A] Grammar Discovery — Notice First
content: From the reading text — find and write:
► 2 sentences with There IS: ________________
► 2 sentences with There ARE: ________________
► 2 imperative sentences: ________________
► 2 prepositions of place: ________________
What is the rule? Discuss with a partner — BEFORE the Formula Box.
Time: 30 min | Individual → Pairs
slides.design_notes: Clean white. Four discovery tasks with orange ► arrows. Writing lines as thin gray lines. Emphasis: 'BEFORE the Formula Box' in orange bold — Discovery First principle.
slides.speaker_notes: Learners must attempt to induce the rule BEFORE seeing the Formula Box. Do not show slide 18 until all groups have written their proposed rule.

slides.title: [B] Formula Box — Grammar A1.1
content: IMPERATIVE: Check the floor jack. / Don't leave tools on the floor.
THERE IS (singular): There IS a spill near the bay door.
THERE ARE (plural): There ARE three tools on the floor.
PREPOSITIONS: in · on · next to · near · under
⚠️ Never add a subject: ~~You check~~ ❌ → Check ✅
⚠️ IS = one thing · ARE = more than one thing
Time: 30 min | Whole group — confirm your discovery
slides.design_notes: Formula box layout: each grammar structure in a separate navy-bordered box. Correct form in orange. Incorrect form with strikethrough in red. Warning signs (⚠️) in orange. Calibri 20pt.
slides.speaker_notes: Show ONLY after learners have written their proposed rules. Compare their rules to the Formula Box. Celebrate correct inferences. Correct gently with recast.

slides.title: [C] Error Log — Fix the 10 Errors
content: ► Each sentence may have ONE error (or no error).
► Identify: G (Grammar) · V (Vocabulary) · WO (Word Order) · Sp (Spelling)
► Write the correct version.
Example: 'You check the floor jack.' → G → 'Check the floor jack.'
Individual: 10 min → Check with partner → Discuss
Time: 40 min | Individual → Pairs
slides.design_notes: Error code legend in a navy sidebar: G / V / WO / Sp with brief definition. Example correction shown in orange. Clean white. Task instructions numbered.
slides.speaker_notes: Do NOT show the answer key slide. After pair discussion, call on pairs for answers. Build the key on the board collaboratively — more effective than reading from a slide.

slides.title: [D] Daily Inspection Checklist — Write It
content: Bay assigned: Bay ___ · Language: 100% English
Minimum 8 items with status (✓ / ✗ / N/A)
Minimum 2 observations: use There is/are + preposition
For any ✗ item: write a Required Action (use imperative verb)
Declare overall bay status: READY or NOT READY + reason
Complete the Work Order header: 6 fields minimum
Time: 70 min | Individual · Peer review with Lista No 2
slides.image: Small: blank Daily Inspection Checklist template thumbnail.
slides.design_notes: Requirements in numbered checklist format. Key requirements (minimum items, language rule) in orange boxes. Status icons (✓/✗/N/A) shown as examples. Word Wall reminder caption.
slides.speaker_notes: Learners use the template from their Learning Guide. Circulate and mark errors in pencil using G/V/Sp/WO codes — do NOT correct aloud. Peer review follows.

slides.title: Evidencia No 2 — Daily Inspection Checklist
content: EVIDENCIA No 2 — Producto
Collect: Checklist + Work Order header + Lista de Verificación No 2
► Submit as a package — all three documents together.
slides.design_notes: MINIMAL layout. White. Collection instruction in orange box. Deliverable list in navy. Nothing else.
slides.speaker_notes: Collect THREE documents as one package: student's checklist + student's Work Order + peer's Lista de Verificación No 2. Do not give oral feedback on scores yet.

slides.title: Session 4: Tuning In & Speaking Up
content: Fase SENA: Apropiación
Focus: Comprensión auditiva + Reporte oral al supervisor
Estrategia: Phase-Based Listening + TBLT + Role Play
Evidencias: E3 — Cuestionario No 3 (Listening) · E4 — Oral Report (Speaking)
Duración: 6 horas
slides.design_notes: Full navy. S4 orange 64pt. Two evidence markers E3 + E4 in orange circles.
slides.speaker_notes: Two evidences in one session. Signal this clearly at the start.

slides.title: [A] Pre-Listening — Key Vocabulary
content: Practise these 5 words BEFORE listening:
SPILL — liquid on the floor
HAZ-ard — a danger
ob-STRUC-tions — things blocking the path
LEAK — liquid coming out of the machine
BAY DOOR — the entrance to the service bay
► Listen for these words. They are in the dialogue.
Time: 20 min | Choral drill → Image match
slides.image: Small icons for each word: spill puddle, hazard triangle, blocked path, dripping pipe, bay door.
slides.design_notes: 5-word pre-teaching table: word / stress marks / visual icon / brief definition. Stress syllables in orange. Icons right-aligned. Keep visible during first listening.
slides.speaker_notes: Choral drill each word 3 times with stress gesture (hand up on stressed syllable). Then: finger drill for 'fire extinguisher' — backchaining.

slides.title: 🎧 Bay 2 Safety Briefing — Listen
content: Listen TWO times.
First: general situation — Who? What?
Second: specific details — Where? What condition?
slides.image: Large headphones icon centered. Or: Bay 2 image projected as visual support during listening.
slides.design_notes: MINIMAL layout. White background. Large headphones icon (or Bay 2 image) — no text distractors. ONLY the two listening instructions. Nothing else. NO vocabulary visible.
slides.speaker_notes: Project Bay 2 image during second listening as visual scaffold. Do NOT show any script. Do NOT show vocabulary during listening. Play audio at 0.85x speed.

slides.title: Cuestionario No 3 — Listening Comprehension
content: EVIDENCIA No 3 — Conocimiento
5 questions · 15 minutes · No script · No audio replay
► Wait for the instructor's signal to begin.
slides.design_notes: MINIMAL layout. White. Evidence label orange box. No vocabulary, no script extract. Nothing that could help answer the questions.
slides.speaker_notes: Distribute Cuestionario No 3 ONLY after both audio plays are complete. Collect quizzes BEFORE distributing the script for the role play. Critical sequence — do not reverse.

slides.title: [C] Role Play — Bay 2 Safety Briefing
content: Role A: Carlos Mendoza — Lead Technician
Role B: Valentina Cruz — Safety Officer
► Read the script with your partner. 2 rounds each.
Focus on: STRESS · INTONATION · Oral markers (OK, Sure, Good, Right)
► Round 2: try from memory — use script only as backup
Time: 40 min | Pairs
slides.image: Two character cards: Carlos (left) and Valentina (right).
slides.design_notes: Character cards with name + role. Role labels in orange. Script reminder in caption. This slide bridges to Speaking (PM-2.8).
slides.speaker_notes: Distribute script ONLY after collecting Cuestionario No 3. Fluency mode — do not interrupt during role play. This activity is a bridge to the oral report.

slides.title: [D] Workshop Readiness Report — Prepare
content: Structure of your report:
1. Open (F4): 'Good morning, Carlos. Bay ___ is ready.'
2. Conditions (F3): 'There is/are ___ [condition]...'
3. Actions: 'I checked the ___.  I inspected the ___.'
4. Problem (if any): 'There is a problem with the ___.'
5. Close (F5): 'Bay ___ is ready. Awaiting your approval.'
Time: 60 min | Round 1 (Stock Cards) → Round 2 → Round 3 (free)
slides.design_notes: 5-step report structure in numbered list. Each step has function label in orange (F4, F3, F5). Steps are short — max 1 line each. Stock Card reminder in caption.
slides.speaker_notes: Round 1: learners read from Stock Cards. Round 2: Sentence Starters only. Round 3: from memory — this is the assessed round. Escala de estimación No 4 used ONLY in Round 3.

slides.title: Evidencia No 4 — Workshop Readiness Report
content: EVIDENCIA No 4 — Desempeño
Round 3 only · 60–90 seconds · No Stock Cards
► Instructor evaluates with Escala de estimación No 4.
slides.design_notes: MINIMAL layout. White. Evidence label orange. Round 3 instruction in navy. Do NOT show assessment criteria on screen.
slides.speaker_notes: Evaluate Round 3 only. Fluency mode — no interruptions. Post-task feedback: write 3 anonymous errors + 3 strengths on board after all presentations.

slides.title: Session 5: The Workshop in Action
content: Fase SENA: Apropiación
Focus: Las 5 funciones comunicativas del taller
Estrategia: CLIL + Simulación + Aprendizaje colaborativo
Evidencia: E5 — Simulación de apertura de taller (Desempeño · 5 pts)
Duración: 6 horas
slides.design_notes: Full navy. S5 orange 64pt. E5 evidence marker orange circle.
slides.speaker_notes: Return scores from E4 in writing at the start of S5 (do not announce orally).

slides.title: [A] Communication Map — 5 Functions
content: F1 — Giving instructions:  Check / Don't leave / Wear your ___
F2 — Requesting tools:     Can I have the ___? / I need the ___
F3 — Describing conditions: There is/are ___ near/next to ___
F4 — Reporting to supervisor: Bay ___ is ready / There is a problem
F5 — Confirming understanding: Understood / Got it / Sorry, repeat?
► You already know these phrases — from S2, S3, S4!
Time: 30 min | Map review → Classification activity
slides.design_notes: 5-row function table. F number in orange circle. Function name navy bold. Example phrase Calibri 20pt italic. Keep this slide as a PERMANENT REFERENCE — return to it during drills and simulation.
slides.speaker_notes: This is the unifying slide for the whole course. Every function was introduced earlier — S5 is integration. Ask: 'Where did we use F3 before?' (S2 vocabulary, S3 grammar). Celebrate the connection.

slides.title: [B] Classify 15 Phrases — Which Function?
content: ► Read each phrase. Write the function: F1 / F2 / F3 / F4 / F5
1. 'Check the fire extinguisher before starting.'
2. 'Can I have the torque wrench, please?'
3. 'There is a spill near the bay door.'
4. 'Bay 2 is ready, Carlos.'
5. 'Understood. I'll do it now.'
Individual 5 min → Compare with partner → Discuss disagreements
Time: 30 min | Individual → Pairs → Plenary
slides.design_notes: 5 example phrases shown (one per function) as representative sample. Full 15-phrase activity is in the Learning Guide. Instructions in orange. Calibri 20pt.
slides.speaker_notes: Show only 5 representative examples on slide. Full 15-card activity is in the Learning Guide. After pairs: call on disagreements only — don't review all 15 on the slide.

slides.title: [C] Function Drills — 5 × 8 minutes
content: F1 Drill: Partner gives situation → You give the instruction
F2 Drill: Partner names a tool → You request it correctly
F3 Drill: Partner shows bay image → You describe 2 conditions
F4 Drill: You report bay status to your 'supervisor'
F5 Drill: Partner gives instruction → You confirm understanding
► Fluency mode — do not stop to correct. Finish the task.
Time: 40 min | Pairs, rotating after each drill
slides.design_notes: 5-row drill table: function / brief drill description. Timer: 8 min shown in orange. Fluency mode reminder in gray italic caption. Rotation arrow icon.
slides.speaker_notes: Timer per drill: 8 minutes. Signal transitions clearly. Do NOT correct during drills — note errors for post-task feedback. After all 5 drills: 5 min anonymous error board.

slides.title: Evidencia No 5 — Workshop Opening Simulation
content: EVIDENCIA No 5 — Desempeño
3-minute simulation · All 5 functions · Live follow-up question
► Instructor + peer observer evaluate simultaneously.
slides.design_notes: MINIMAL layout. White. Evidence label orange. Dual evaluator reminder (instructor + peer) in navy. No function list visible — learners must recall from memory.
slides.speaker_notes: Both instructor and peer observer evaluate simultaneously with Escala de estimación No 5. Do not share scores orally. Written feedback delivered at start of S6. Collective feedback after all simulations: 3 most successful functions + 2 most frequent gaps.

slides.title: WRAP-UP S5 — Personal Communication Card
content: Personal Communication Card: 2 phrases per function — YOUR phrases
This card belongs to you — keep it for the Final Mission
Exit ticket: Share 1 favorite phrase from your card
Preview S6: Cuestionario Consolidado — 25 questions, 5 skills
Autonomous work: Practice 5-function simulation — record yourself (60 sec)
slides.image: Small: Personal Communication Card template thumbnail.
slides.design_notes: Personal Communication Card reminder in orange box. Exit ticket in navy. Preview S6 in gray italic. Autonomy task in caption.
slides.speaker_notes: Share-out: each learner says 1 favorite phrase. Write them on the board — creates community. End S5 with energy and confidence.

slides.title: Session 6: Prove What You Know
content: Fase SENA: Apropiación — Evaluación Consolidada
Focus: Demostrar dominio integrado A1.1
Evidencia: E6 — Cuestionario Consolidado No 6 (25 pts)
Sections: Reading · Vocabulary · Grammar · Listening · Language Functions
Duración: 3 horas (evaluación) + orientación Final Mission
slides.design_notes: Full navy. S6 orange 64pt. E6 evidence marker — prominent. 5 skill sections listed clearly.
slides.speaker_notes: Return written feedback from E4 and E5 at the start of S6. Give 10 minutes for learners to read feedback before the quiz.

slides.title: SET-UP S6 — Review Your Results
content: Your E4 and E5 feedback is returned today.
► Read your feedback: What was your strongest function?
► What will you focus on in the Cuestionario today?
Cuestionario Consolidado No 6: 25 items · 5 sections · 90 minutes
Minimum to pass: 15 / 25 (60%)
Time: 20 min review + 90 min quiz
slides.design_notes: Pass threshold (15/25) in orange bold. Feedback review instruction in navy. Quiz structure summary in table: Section / Items / Points.
slides.speaker_notes: Distribute E4 and E5 written feedback. Give 10 min to read. Then: 5 min recap — 'What are you most confident about today?' Do not review content — this is not a study session.

slides.title: Cuestionario Consolidado No 6
content: EVIDENCIA No 6 — Conocimiento
25 items · 90 minutes · No dictionary · No notes
Section 4 (Listening): Wait for instructor's signal — audio plays TWICE.
slides.design_notes: MINIMAL layout. White. Evidence label prominent orange. Audio instruction for Listening section in orange alert box. Nothing else. Absolute minimum distractors.
slides.speaker_notes: Distribute quizzes only after all feedback has been collected. Listening section: play audio after learners have read Section 4 questions. Play twice: gist first, detail second.

slides.title: [B] Final Mission — Bay Assignment
content: The Final Mission: 3 sessions (S6b + S7 + S8)
Group 1 → Bay 1 · Group 2 → Bay 2 · Group 3 → Bay 3
S6b: Visit your bay. Start your checklist draft.
S7: Inspect, write final checklist, prepare oral report.
S8: Deliver oral report to supervisor. 60–90 seconds.
► Write your bay assignment here: Bay _______
Time: 30 min orientation
slides.image: Small: bay layout diagram with Bay 1/2/3 labeled.
slides.design_notes: Bay assignments in large orange text. 3-session timeline as horizontal arrow. Deliverables in numbered list. Write space for bay number.
slides.speaker_notes: Announce bay assignments clearly and publicly. Groups go to their bay at the end of this session for a 40-minute reconnaissance visit.

slides.title: Sessions 6b · 7 · 8: The Final Mission
content: Fase SENA: Transferencia
S6b: Orientación + Reconocimiento del bay
S7: Inspección real + Checklist + Preparación oral
S8: Misión Final oral + KWL cierre + Gap Card S1 vs S8
Evaluación: TRANSFERENCIA — formativa (no evidencia GFPI adicional)
Duración: 2.5h + 6h + 6h
slides.image: Small: real bay image — mechanic inspecting.
slides.design_notes: Full navy. '6b·7·8' in orange 48pt top-left. Mission title white 32pt. Three session blocks listed with durations in orange. Formative note in gray italic.
slides.speaker_notes: This is the capstone. All 5 functions, all vocabulary, all grammar — used for real. Instructor becomes 'Carlos Mendoza' from this point.

slides.title: S6b — Bay Reconnaissance
content: Go to your assigned bay. OBSERVE — don't write yet.
► What is the condition of the floor?
► Is the fire extinguisher accessible?
► Are all tools in the toolbox?
► Is PPE available: gloves · goggles · hard hat?
► Take notes in English. Sketch the layout.
Time: 40 min | Bay groups · Instructor circulates
slides.image: Bay layout diagram (blank) for learners to sketch.
slides.design_notes: 4 observation questions in orange bullet format. Bay layout sketch area suggested in caption. Clear ENGLISH ONLY reminder.
slides.speaker_notes: Instructor circulates bay to bay (~12 min each). Coaching mode: speak only English. Ask: 'What is that tool? Where is the fire extinguisher?' Connect to Toolbelt vocabulary.

slides.title: S7 — Inspection + Checklist + Coaching
content: INSPECT: Walk your bay. Write the final checklist (minimum 8 items).
WRITE: Clean version — 2 observations in English · Bay status declared
PREPARE: Oral report outline (5 bullets — NOT a script)
PRACTISE: Coaching pairs — 2 rounds × 90 seconds each
REVIEW: Self-evaluate with 10 criteria from Lista No 2
► Tomorrow is the Final Mission. You are ready.
Time: 6 hours | Bay inspection + Classroom preparation
slides.design_notes: 4 sequential action steps (INSPECT / WRITE / PREPARE / PRACTISE) in navy bold left column. Details in Calibri 20pt right column. Motivational closer in orange italic.
slides.speaker_notes: This is a work session. Instructor circulates between bay groups. Error marking in pencil only (G/V/Sp/WO). Coaching pairs: use Escala de estimación No 5 criteria as feedback framework.

slides.title: S8 — The Final Mission
content: 60–90 seconds. English only. No script.
I am Carlos Mendoza. You are Santiago Ríos.
Bay inspection complete. Report to me. Go.
slides.image: Optional: Carlos Mendoza character card, large.
slides.design_notes: MINIMAL layout. White or navy. Carlos Mendoza character image if available. Three lines only — maximum impact. 'Go.' in orange bold.
slides.speaker_notes: Absolute FLUENCY mode. No interruptions. No corrections. Instructor is Carlos — stay in character. 1 follow-up question after each report. Other learners: update their Personal Communication Card while listening.

slides.title: S8 — Reflection: KWL Column L
content: Column L — What did you LEARN?
► Complete column L of your KWL table now.
► What is the most important thing you learned in English?
► Share: one sentence from your L column.
Examples: 'I learned 20 workshop tools in English.'
'I can describe a spill in English.'
Time: 30 min | Individual → Group share-out
slides.design_notes: KWL table shown with Column L highlighted in orange. L column example answers in italic. Instructor fills the class KWL on the board during share-out.
slides.speaker_notes: Return to the physical KWL from S1 — now complete the L column together. Call on 4–5 volunteers. Write their L answers on the board. This closes the learning cycle visually.

slides.title: S8 — Gap Card: S1 vs S8
content: Return to your Gap Card from Session 1.
Rate yourself again — the same 6 I can statements.
► Compare: Where did you start? Where are you now?
Write: 'In Session 1, I couldn't ___. Now I can ___.'
Share: 3 volunteers read their reflection in English.
Time: 30 min | Individual → Pairs → Plenary
slides.design_notes: Before/after comparison format: two columns, S1 vs S8. Writing frame ('In S1 I couldn't... Now I can...') in orange box. Celebrate growth — this is a milestone moment.
slides.speaker_notes: Redistribute the Gap Cards collected in S1. Most learners will see significant growth. Create space to celebrate. Do not rush this reflection.

slides.title: Guía 1 — Complete.
content: Bay is ready. Checklist: complete.
You inspected the workshop.
You wrote the checklist — in English.
You reported to your supervisor — in English.
That is A1.1 — achieved.
Next: Guía 2 — The Workshop Specialist A1.2
slides.image: Full-bleed: mechanic giving thumbs up in a clean, organized bay. Or: Bay 2 READY sign.
slides.design_notes: Full navy background with image at 40% overlay. Title white Arial Bold 40pt. Bullets white Calibri 22pt. 'Next: Guía 2' in orange at bottom. Logo SENA bottom-right. Closing energy.
slides.speaker_notes: Closing ceremony: one word in English from each learner about their experience. Write the words on the board. Leave them visible. Take a photo of the class KWL with column L complete.

evidence_slides.note: All evidence slides use MINIMAL layout — no vocabulary, no answers visible, no distractors.
